# PM2.5 against WHO 2021 Air Quality Guidelines

Code `who_2021_pm25` · version 2021 · scale: levels 1–6 · method: step

- [WHO global air quality guidelines (2021), Table 0.1, as reproduced in ETC HE Report 2024/17 Table 1.2](https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240034228), accessed 2026-10-21

## Rules

- The 24-h mean PM2.5 is compared with the WHO 2021 24-h AQG level (15) and interim targets IT4 25, IT3 37.5, IT2 50, IT1 75 (ug/m3), using inclusive upper bounds and no rounding.
- The API also reports the concentration as a multiple of the guideline (C / 15), which is easy to compare across countries.

## Implementation notes and source discrepancies

- reference_guidelines lists [IT1, IT2, IT3, IT4, AQG] for every pollutant. Insight pages use it for annual comparisons.
- Requiring 18 of 24 valid hours is our choice, matching the strictest 24-h rule used elsewhere in AirAtlas.
